commit 67fd618f72154af7aca91428cdfb23583464a478
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Dec 3 07:49:31 2024 +0200
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Dec 3 07:49:31 2024 +0200

    Bug 1934458 - Do not treat LDFLAGS as a bash array to appease shellcheck. r=dandarnell
    
    
    It's not an array, do not treat it as such.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D230828

diff --git a/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh b/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
index f8e895c0858..89fb1b3c2c6 100755
--- a/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
@@ -141,7 +141,8 @@ function build_libotr() {
     case "${_TARGET_OS}" in
         win*)
             cd src
-            "${CC}" -static-libgcc -s -shared -Wl,-no-undefined "${LDFLAGS[@]}" -o libotr.dll \
+            # shellcheck disable=SC2086
+            "${CC}" -static-libgcc -s -shared -Wl,-no-undefined ${LDFLAGS} -o libotr.dll \
                 ./*.o \
                 -L"${_PREFIX}/lib" "${_PREFIX}/lib/libgcrypt.a" "${_PREFIX}/lib/libgpg-error.a" \
                 -L"${_LIBDIR}" -lws2_32 -lssp
@@ -149,7 +150,8 @@ function build_libotr() {
             ;;
         linux*)
             cd src
-            "${CC}" -shared "${LDFLAGS[@]}" -Wl,-soname -Wl,libotr.so \
+            # shellcheck disable=SC2086
+            "${CC}" -shared ${LDFLAGS} -Wl,-soname -Wl,libotr.so \
               .libs/*.o \
               -L"${_PREFIX}/lib" "${_PREFIX}/lib/libgcrypt.a" "${_PREFIX}/lib/libgpg-error.a" \
               --sysroot="${MOZ_FETCHES_DIR}/${SYSROOT}" \
